crate_scope: http 1.5.0; direct inclusion of production method.rs and ascii.rs; isolated method leaf verification, not an integrated proof of all HTTP modules

notable_proofs.canonical_method_text_is_injective: 515 proved leaves: finite case split over the 12 MethodModel variants on each side (12x12 pairs); accepted as a bounded finite proof.
notable_proofs.method_ascii_cmp_preserved: 5 proved own leaves; used by Method::cmp to bridge text comparison to lexicographic byte-model comparison for canonical ASCII methods.
notable_proofs.builder_constructors: Nine exact constructor helpers for GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, HEAD, CONNECT, PATCH, OPTIONS, TRACE; each has exact model and invariant postconditions and a fresh 1/1 body proof.
notable_proofs.hash_scope: Method structural Hash body/refinement chain and extension bodies preserve the valid hasher invariant. No digest equality or general Hash coherence claim is made. The manual Inner body is runtime-tested against a test-only mirror enum with the original derived Hash protocol.
notable_proofs.format_scope: Method Debug/Display have exact successful-output refinements; InvalidMethod Debug/Display prove formatter append preservation only.

coverage: all 256 byte values against an independent RFC token allowlist
recorded Hasher callbacks against a derived mirror for all 12 Inner variants

scope_limitations: This harness proves only included Method and ASCII source bodies plus the stated standard-library contracts; it is not an integrated proof of the full HTTP crate.
Standard hasher callback contracts are invariant-preservation boundaries; these proofs do not specify digest contents.

Existing creusot_std::std::string::injective_to_bytes is a trusted standard-library lemma used to connect String/str comparisons to their UTF-8 byte models; the Method-specific ASCII order transport is proved.
The standard str::from_utf8_unchecked specification supplies the unchecked conversion contract; Method and Status ASCII/UTF-8 validity witnesses are proved in the included source targets.

Formatter::write_str and NonZeroU16 model/get/new specs are standard-library external contracts; formatter_extends is an open logic definition, and its transitivity helper is proved using the separately proved seq_concat_assoc lemma.

post_snapshot_reemission.reason_for_no_additional_why3_run: After the source update, the exact package was cleaned and freshly translated. Every accepted target COMA is byte-for-byte identical to its COMA SHA-256 from the completed no-cache proof batch. Proof JSON was reused only for those identical task bytes; no target was added, removed, or changed.
